titles.title: A Woman of Paris
titles.plot: Marie St. Clair (Edna Purviance) is a desperate young woman who suspects she has been dumped by her flighty fiancé, Jean (Carl Miller), after he mysteriously stands her up at a railway station, where they were to meet in order to travel to Paris together. She goes off to Paris alone, where she meets wealthy Pierre Revel (Adolphe Menjou) and becomes his mistress. But a year later she meets Jean again and, suddenly caught between two men, isn't sure where her heart truly lies.

titles.title: All This and Heaven Too
titles.plot: Henriette Deluzy-Desportes serves as the governess to the children of the Duc de Praslin and his wife, the duchess. While both the Duc de Praslin and his children adore Henriette, the duchess despises her, and is suspicious of the bond she has formed with her family. As the duchess's behavior toward Henriette grows more and more irrational, it puts into play tragic events that will change all their lives forever.

titles.title: Always Yours, Never Mine
titles.plot: Across thirty years and different versions of themselves, two people keep finding each other at the edges of their lives. Yet every reunion arrives with a choice, and every choice leads them toward one life while taking them farther from another.

titles.title: Beyond the Rocks
titles.plot: Theodora Fitzgerald (Gloria Swanson) doesn't love Josiah Brown (Robert Bolder), but she agrees to marry the older millionaire so he can provide for her father and two sisters. Just as the young socialite has consigned herself to living in a loveless marriage, she meets the suave and handsome Lord Bracondale (Rudolph Valentino). Although she falls madly in love with Bracondale almost immediately, Theodora tries to resist his charms, but she can quell her love for only so long.

titles.title: Clashing Through the Snow
titles.plot: In this romantic comedy, a holiday snowstorm strands rival publishing editors Ryan Mitchell (Chris Briney) and Hannah Hendricks (Michelle Randolph) at the airport, forcing them into a shared rental car for a cross-country race to New York. With budget cuts threatening to eliminate one of their jobs, both are secretly chasing a career-saving deal, turning every mile into a high-stakes showdown. But between roadside mishaps, unexpected detours and small-town charm, the holiday spirit has a way of melting even the fiercest rivalry into something neither of them saw coming.

titles.title: Doing Life
titles.plot: A single mother fighting to survive and a reformed ex-con with untapped talent find in each other an unlikely second chance.

titles.title: Eternal Return
titles.plot: In this timeless romance, Cass (Naomi Scott) is resigned to a life without love until she meets Virgil (Kit Harington), an enigmatic mapmaker who charts courses to imaginary places. Their fantastical adventure through London compels Cass to choose between the past she left behind and a future she never saw coming.

titles.title: Flesh and the Devil
titles.plot: In this silent drama, lifelong school chums Leo (John Gilbert) and Ulrich (Lars Hanson) are soldiers in the German army. Leo falls in love with Countess Felicitas (Greta Garbo) and courts her, which enrages her husband (Marc McDermott). When Leo fights a duel with and kills the Count, he is deployed to Africa for five years as punishment. Leo returns to find that Ulrich has fallen for Felicitas, but she resumes her amorous pursuit of Leo, thus pushing the limits of their friendship.

titles.title: Guarding Stars
titles.plot: When a no-nonsense bodyguard is assigned to protect a charming action star over the holidays sparks fly, secrets unravel, and Christmas gets a whole lot more complicated.

titles.title: Ha-Chan, Shake Your Booty!
titles.plot: Haru and Luis love competing in Tokyo's ballroom dance scene, but after tragedy strikes, Haru withdraws into isolation. When friends coax her back to the studio, she develops an infatuation with the new instructor.

titles.title: Hello, Love, Again
titles.plot: After fighting for their love to conquer time, distance and a global shutdown that keeps them apart, Joy and Ethan meet again in Canada but realize that they have also changed a lot, individually.

titles.title: Hershey
titles.plot: Based on the life of Milton Hershey, founder of the iconic Hershey chocolate company. Milton's grit and determination to conquer the world of candy-making propel him from bankruptcy to monumental success, and the love of his life, Kitty, helps him build a legacy sweeter than any candy bar. But when Kitty falls ill, Milton's wild optimism teeters on the edge of destruction, and she sparks an even bolder dream: to leave their fortune in the hands of America's children in need.

titles.title: In Spite of Ourselves
titles.plot: Love comes easy -- relationships don't. When Hannah, a warm and determined Portland, OR baker, crosses paths with Archie, an up-and-coming LA comedian with a habit of dodging commitment, their instant chemistry sparks a whirlwind romance neither expected. But after two blissful weeks together, real life pulls them back to separate cities, forcing them to confront distance, doubts, and their own hilariously messy insecurities. Heartfelt, funny, and deeply relatable, IN SPITE OF OURSELVES follows two imperfect people trying to figure out whether they can move past their fears -- and give love a real chance.

titles.title: La Bola Negra
titles.plot: LA BOLA NEGRA tells the story of three men whose lives are intimately connected through desire, pain and inheritance, across three different eras -- 1932, 1937, and 2017.

titles.title: LAX: Holiday in New York
titles.plot: LAX 3, officially titled LAX: Holiday in New York, is the explosive final chapter in the trilogy written, directed by, and starring Carl Jackson. The film sees the return of Andrea McClew and Crystal Santos, alongside new cast members, Billy Joseph Jr., Zoe Johnson, Brazilian film star Amanda de Godoi, and 13-year-old Anahita Singh in a pivotal role that ultimately connects the entire saga. Set against a holiday-lit New York City, the story follows John and Kelly, in the middle of a divorce but determined to spend one last Christmas holiday together as a family--until secrets resurface, tensions ignite, and it becomes clear that coming together may have been their most dangerous mistake yet.

trailer.title: LAX: Holiday in New York: Trailer 1

titles.title: Love
titles.plot: Tolstoy's Anna Karenina becomes a widow in Russia and marries the dashing soldier Vronsky.

titles.title: Love Language
titles.plot: Following a failed engagement, aspiring author Louisa "Lou" Klaussner (Chloë Grace Moretz) falls into a side hustle writing wedding vows for other people. Just as the charming serial dater Dash (Anthony Ramos) starts to show interest in Lou, she reconnects with her college best friend and long-time crush Warren (Manny Jacinto). She is shocked to learn that Warren is the fiancé of Olivia (Isabel May), one of Lou's wedding vow clients... putting Lou in the middle of a complicated love-rectangle.

titles.title: Love of Your Life
titles.plot: Directed by Rachel Morrison (The Fire Inside), LOVE OF YOUR LIFE follows Maya (Margaret Qualley), whose chance encounter with Charlie (Gabriel Basso) sets in motion a sweeping romance and a future beyond anything she had imagined. When that future is suddenly upended, Maya is sent hurtling toward an unexpected new life--one that will force her to reckon with who she is, what she wants, and how to love again.

titles.title: The Mysterious Lady
titles.plot: Russian spy Tania Fedorova (Greta Garbo) uses her seductive charms to steal precious secrets for the motherland. Few saboteurs can compete with her skills, as her handler, Gen. Boris Alexandroff (Gustav von Seyffertitz), knows well. But Tania's career in espionage is jeopardized when she meets a handsome Austrian, Capt. Karl von Raden (Conrad Nagel), who's also her latest target. Will Tania sever her ties with her country, not to mention risk Alexandroff's wrath, in the name of love?

titles.title: Paper Flowers
titles.plot: Based on a true story, Paper Flowers follows Shalin Shah, a compassionate USC graduate who leaves behind the expectations of his Indian-American family and the life he has built with his longtime girlfriend Fiona, to serve as a Peace Corps volunteer in Peru. Driven by a desire to make a meaningful difference, Shalin embraces the uncertainty of a path that feels wholly his own. But when a persistent cough leads to a devastating diagnosis of synovial sarcoma, a rare and aggressive cancer, Shalin is forced to return home and confront a future he never anticipated. Surrounded by his family, Fiona, and his closest friends, he begins to reconsider what it means to live with purpose when time can no longer be taken for granted. As Shalin's perspective deepens, his reflections on gratitude, love, and mortality inspire the essay "Thank You, Cancer," which is published by HuffPost and goes viral with readers around the world. A devastatingly beautiful story of family, resilience, and the lasting impact of one life, Paper Flowers is a reminder to cherish the people we love and the moments that give life meaning. #SunsetsForShalin

titles.title: Remember
titles.plot: An estranged couple, who have forgotten what it means to love each other, find themselves pretending to be together again for the sake of their daughter, whose memory is fading. As they remember their past, they learn that love has a long memory. All it sometimes needs is one miracle to remember.

titles.title: The Rose Tattoo
titles.plot: Based on a play by Tennessee Williams, this classic drama centers on Serafina, a widowed Sicilian woman living in the American South who is left devastated by the death of her husband. Grief turns her into a recluse; however, she is drawn back into the world when she learns of her late husband's infidelities. Meanwhile, the arrival of a new lodger, handsome truck driver Alvaro, offers hope of a new love in her life.

titles.title: Sense and Sensibility
titles.plot: From Focus Features and Working Title comes an irresistible new take on Jane Austen's iconic Sense and Sensibility: a charming, witty, and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood starring Daisy Edgar-Jones and Esmé Creed-Miles.

titles.title: The Sheik
titles.plot: Paris-educated Sheik Ahmed Ben Hassan (Rudolph Valentino) provides brides for wealthy Arabs. The high-spirited Lady Diana Mayo (Agnes Ayres), learning that the sheik will be in the city of Biskra, Algeria, playfully decides to disguise herself as a dancing girl to become one of the prospective brides, yet is unable to go through with the deception -- much to Ahmed's amusement. Hearing that Diana will be touring the Sahara Desert, Ahmed abducts her, intending to make her fall in love with him.

titles.title: Sunrise
titles.plot: Bored with his wife (Janet Gaynor), their baby and the dull routine of farm life, a farmer (George O'Brien) falls under the spell of a flirtatious city girl (Margaret Livingston) who convinces him to drown his wife so they can escape together. When his wife becomes suspicious of his plan and runs away to the city, the farmer pursues her, slowly regaining her trust as the two rediscover their love for each other in this award-winning silent classic.

titles.title: Supernova
titles.plot: Sam (Academy Award winner Colin Firth) and Tusker (Academy Award nominee Stanley Tucci), partners of twenty years, are traveling across England in their old camper van visiting friends, family and places from their past. Following a life-changing diagnosis, their time together has become more important than ever until secret plans test their love like never before.

titles.title: The Christmas Switch
titles.plot: Craving a change of pace, a work-hard-play-hard city girl swaps lives with her homebody sister at Christmastime — only to unwrap a whole new kind of mess.

titles.title: The Love Hypothesis
titles.plot: Based on the New York Times best-selling novel by Ali Hazelwood, The Love Hypothesis follows Olive (Lili Reinhart), a brilliant Ph.D. candidate focused on her future in academia. But when she realizes her best friend Anh (Rachel Marsh) has fallen for her crush Jeremy (Nicholas Duvernay), Olive impulsively kisses intimidating professor Adam Carlsen (Tom Bateman) to prove she’s moved on. What begins as a desperate act of friendship spirals into a fake relationship with rules, boundaries, and a mutually beneficial agreement. When their arrangement begins to blur the lines between performance and reality, Olive is forced to test her most daunting hypothesis yet: that love might actually be worth the risk.

titles.title: Why Did I Get Married Again?
titles.original_title: Why Did I Get Married Again?
titles.plot: In Tyler Perry's "Why Did I Get Married Again?", the couples reunite in celebration as Marcus and Angela's daughter prepares to tie the knot. After being apart for quite some time, they learn quickly that as much as things change, they stay the same. Realizing their children have grown up to be so much like them, they must reflect on the examples they've set and ask themselves that age-old question, why did they get married... again?

titles.title: You+Me - Against the World
titles.plot: Alma Lancaster (Vittoria Di Savoia), 18, appears to lead a perfect life within a wealthy family who believes she is studying law. In secret, she pursues her true dream: filmmaking. On campus, she meets Vadim Arcadi (Lucas Barski), 20, a magnetic and solitary rebel with a troubled past. Forced to collaborate on a student film, they clash, grow closer and fall in love -- despite themselves. But someone is watching them, determined to tear them apart and expose secrets that could destroy both Alma and Vadim.
